prompt: Plate for an illustrated field guide: a small low floating isle with a curved sandy bay and glowing shallows, a colossal iron anchor half buried in the shore with its chain running off the edge, ropes and chains descending through a well in the rock, wooden racks of salvaged old-world stone, dark storm clouds churning not far below, seen from a slight aerial angle. Soft vignette fading to warm parchment at the edges. Style: hand-painted stylized game art, painterly, soft lighting with gentle rim light, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous fantasy, never grim.
